mapper.sql: id, user_id, receiver, phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from user_address where user_id = #{userId} and is_default = 1 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into user_address (user_id, receiver, phone, province, city, district, detail_address, is_default, create_time, update_time) values (#{userId},#{receiver},#{phone},#{province},#{city},#{district},#{detailAddress},#{isDefault},#{createTime},#{updateTime})
mapper.update: update user_address set receiver=#{receiver}, phone=#{phone}, province=#{province}, city=#{city}, district=#{district}, detail_address=#{detailAddress}, is_default=#{isDefault}, create_time=now() where id=#{id} and user_id=#{userId}
mapper.delete: delete from user_address where id = #{id} and user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: update user_address set is_default = 0, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId}
